dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah yes. Okay, so let's say the world really was on the brink of destruction — how would you even know that anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: That is one of a merchant's other talents. Not only must we read the market and act accordingly, so too must we have our connections.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I happen to be in the know about some very top secret intel. Intel which has come from none other than the economic authority that is the Qixing themselves.
